jobs.title: Event Security Specialist — Flexible Hours, $22/HR, Paid Training
jobs.description:
Allied Universal Event Services is seeking part-time Event Security staff for football games and other events in the Dallas area. Earn $22/hr with weekly pay, paid training, and flexible schedules that fit your lifestyle.

Responsibilities include bag checks, access control, and policy enforcement to ensure guest safety and a positive experience. Must be 18+, with a high school diploma or equivalent, and able to pass a background check and drug screening.

jobs.description:
BEST Crowd Management in Arlington, TX is seeking an Event Security Officer for AT&T Stadium. This part-time role focuses on ensuring the safety of attendees, staff, and property during high-profile events and games.
